num.description: the number this store gave it in its prefix's series, counting up: with the prefix, what a human id such as B-7 is built from. A write may set it, change it, or clear it with null; a pair another entity holds is refused

prefix.description: the letter of the series its number belongs to, fixed when it is first numbered: B-7 and A-7 are two entities. Absent on a row numbered before series had letters, which answers to its number under any letter
